scope: S118 selected measured-body, face/blink, foot-motion, family identity, dossier controls and status-note improvements.

findings: No new mandatory crown, pole or canthal defect in current optimized head.
Controls and status readable across desktop/mobile dark/light.
Stylized face shading and procedural hair remain limitations.
All 28 current frames independently inspected across desktop/mobile, dark/light and six modes plus mobile front/profile.
No mandatory visible joint, silhouette, visibility or readability defect.
Stylized torso/materials remain an art limitation; reduced-motion snapshots do not establish physical mobile frame rate.
All eight actual family dossiers inspected across both themes and viewports; shared family background/pigment with individual faces and reload consistency.

Fresh final-build body/family pass: all36 frames exactly hash-identical to independently inspected captures; primary reopened desktop dark running and mobile light jump. Runtime provenance refreshed to current owner-fix source.
fixesApplied: Closed-eye canthal returns and crown preservation.
Closed torso caps and correct torso draw batching.
Gentler measured limb/torso envelopes, clothing relief and articulated swing feet.
Saved family authority and correct name-only dossier opener.

limitations: Stylized procedural characters; no photorealism claim.
Modeled segment volume is not validated tissue mass or closed whole-character union volume.
Headless emulated viewports do not establish physical mobile frame rate.
Historical S117 broader naturalism/actual-user 20–30-season evidence remains unselected and unproven.

previousReceipt.note: Preserved unchanged; its broader open craft claim is not silently promoted by the narrower S118 evidence.
